# Film Festival Poster

[Photo](../README.md) › [Posters & Marketing](../README.md#posters--marketing) · `poster` `shapes` `layer-styles` `blend-modes` `noise` `type`

An outdoor film festival poster with a gold film reel, crossing spotlight beams, a perforated film strip and film grain.

|---|---|

## About

Everything graphic is a live shape with holes cut by subtraction: the reel is a circle minus a
hub and six windows, and the film strip is a band minus 46 perforations, so the dark backdrop
shows through. Two translucent searchlight beams in Screen mode rise from behind the reel, the reel takes a
Gradient Overlay and a Bevel & Emboss, and an Overlay layer of monochrome noise adds film grain.
